name: application-notification-center
title: Notification Center
description: Bell-triggered dropdown panel listing grouped notifications with read/unread state, timestamps, and a mark-all-read action.
useWhen: Surfacing a list of grouped, time-ordered notifications from a bell icon in an app header.
Users need to see unread state at a glance and clear it in bulk with mark-all-read.
Notifications persist and are revisited, unlike single toasts which are ephemeral.
avoidWhen: The message is a one-time, transient confirmation — use a toast instead.
You need a full-page notification history with filtering and search — link out to a dedicated page from the 'View all' action instead.
There is only ever one active notification at a time — a single badge or inline alert is simpler.
responsiveBehavior: The panel is a fixed 20rem (w-80) width anchored to the right edge of its trigger; on narrow viewports, constrain or reposition it within your own header layout.
accessibility: The trigger button carries aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded, and an aria-label announcing the unread count.
The panel uses role="dialog" with an aria-label so screen readers announce it as a distinct region.
Unread items are distinguished by more than color alone: an explicit dot plus full, non-truncated text contrast.

variants.title: Notification Center
variants.description: Bell trigger with unread dot, grouped Today/Earlier sections, per-item read state, and mark-all-read and view-all actions.
accessibility: Each notification is a focusable link so keyboard users can tab through and activate items.

variants.title: Notification Center (Dark)
variants.description: Bell-triggered notification dropdown adapted for dark application surfaces.
accessibility: Unread indicator and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark surfaces.
